text:
name: self_recommending_experiment
question: >-
  Can an async worker observe the measured corpus + knowledge base, author the next
  highest-value experiment (a new spec or a targeted re-run), enqueue it with providers
  interleaved, measure the regret, and write the finding — i.e. is the emergent self-healing
  loop observed on 2026-08-15 a reusable, repeatable experiment shape?
version: "0.1"
workflow:
  kind: agent_task
  params:
    language: python
    fork: true
    model_pool:
      - deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro
      - deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash
    context:
      prior_art: >-
        This generalizes the emergent behavior documented in
        code_reviews/2026-08-15_self-healing-remediation-finding.md: the remediation worker
        diagnosed contamination, authored a re-run experiment, enqueued it, and spawned workers.
      enabling_merge: >-
        A knowledge-base branch is pending; once merged with the instrumented ledger, `observe`
        reads the whole measured corpu…
